phase_1.title: Phase 1 · HK416D Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.56×45mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 430 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 430 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 368 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 865 m/s (1495 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 30-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the HK416D staged for its 850 RPM cyclic · Over-the-Beach capable cadence.

zh.headline: H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪：2004 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 黑克勒-科赫应美军特种作战需求打造的 HK416D 保留了 M4 全部人机操控习惯，却将导气系统彻底替换为源于 G36 的自调短行程活塞顶杆，使火药高温积碳与污垢完全阻隔于机匣之外。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：HK416D 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2004 年问世的 H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 由德国黑克勒-科赫（Heckler & Koch）主导研制，定位为经典的模块化突击步枪。HK416 衍生型号不仅被美国海军陆战队列装为 M27 IAR 班用自动步枪，还先后成为挪威、法国（HK416F）及德国联邦国防军新一代制式步枪基础。
黑克勒-科赫应美军特种作战需求打造的 HK416D 保留了 M4 全部人机操控习惯，却将导气系统彻底替换为源于 G36 的自调短行程活塞顶杆，使火药高温积碳与污垢完全阻隔于机匣之外。 整件装备总长 851 mm（托展）/ 755 mm（托缩）、空重 3.49 kg，成为同期模块化步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2004 年，德国黑克勒-科赫（Heckler & Koch）推出了划时代的H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪。HK416 衍生型号不仅被美国海军陆战队列装为 M27 IAR 班用自动步枪，还先后成为挪威、法国（HK416F）及德国联邦国防军新一代制式步枪基础。 它的核心设计聚焦于短行程活塞与独立顶杆阻隔高温火药燃气进入枪机框，显著降低机匣温升与积碳，奠定了其在模块化步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 的机械灵魂在于其「G36 系短行程导气活塞顶杆 · 7 突笋回转枪机与冷锻重枪管」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。加高 9 mm 上机匣配合浮置式四面皮卡汀尼护木消除活塞偏心敲击偏移，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 采用G36 系短行程导气活塞顶杆 · 7 突笋回转枪机与冷锻重枪管。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了加高 9 mm 上机匣配合浮置式四面皮卡汀尼护木消除活塞偏心敲击偏移。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.56×45mm NATO 弹药规格与 368 mm（14.5 in）冷锻镀铬重枪管（6 条右旋 · 178 mm / 1:7 缠距），最高工作膛压约 430 MPa，可赋予弹头 865 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,495 J 动能，有效作用距离达 500 米。
内膛技术特点方面，H&K 专有冷锻内膛工艺（标称寿命逾 20,000 发），1:7 缠距适配 77 gr 重弹。同时，枪机框尾部排水槽与防回弹缓冲器支持「涉水出水秒射」（Over-the-Beach），令其在 850 发/分（全自动）· 涉水排水即射 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 368 毫米身管与 5.56×45mm NATO 口径，H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 实现了每秒 865 米的初速与 500 米有效射程。H&K 专有冷锻内膛工艺（标称寿命逾 20,000 发），1:7 缠距适配 77 gr 重弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 32 mm 膛轴设计，H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 5.1 N·s 水平。H&K 冷锻重型枪管在加装消音器高频连发工况下仍保持极高热稳定性。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-38）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 30 发容量的30 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，H&K 冷锻重型枪管在加装消音器高频连发工况下仍保持极高热稳定性。欢迎在 BAY-38 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Heckler & Koch HK416D: The 2004 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Engineered with U.S. special operations input, the HK416D retains full M4 ergonomics while replacing direct gas impingement with a G36-derived short-stroke piston tappet that vents hot carbon forward of the receiver. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-38.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the HK416D
paragraphs: Introduced in 2004 by Heckler & Koch in Germany, the Heckler & Koch HK416D emerged as a defining Modular Assault Carbine. Beyond special-operations fame, the HK416 architecture was adopted by the USMC as the M27 IAR and selected as the standard service rifle of Norway, France (HK416F), and Germany.

Engineered with U.S. special operations input, the HK416D retains full M4 ergonomics while replacing direct gas impingement with a G36-derived short-stroke piston tappet that vents hot carbon forward of the receiver. Measuring 851 mm (Extended) / 755 mm (Collapsed) at an unloaded weight of 3.49 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Assault & Battle Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2004, Heckler & Koch of Germany introduced the Heckler & Koch HK416D. Beyond special-operations fame, the HK416 architecture was adopted by the USMC as the M27 IAR and selected as the standard service rifle of Norway, France (HK416F), and Germany. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Short-stroke piston keeps hot propellant fouling forward of the bolt carrier group — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Heckler & Koch HK416D sits its G36-Derived Short-Stroke Gas Piston Tappet · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt & OTB Reliability. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 430 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Raised upper receiver and free-float quad rail accommodate piston stroke cleanly, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Heckler & Koch HK416D relies on G36-Derived Short-Stroke Gas Piston Tappet · 7-Lug Rotating Bolt & OTB Reliability. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Raised upper receiver and free-float quad rail accommodate piston stroke cleanly.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.56×45mm NATO with 368 mm (14.5 in) Cold Hammer-Forged Barrel (6-Groove RH · 1:7" Twist), the Heckler & Koch HK416D develops 865 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,495 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 500 meters.

Internally, H&K cold hammer-forged barrel rated beyond 20,000 rounds with 1:7" twist for heavy 77 gr projectiles. Combined with its 850 RPM cyclic · Over-the-Beach capable tempo, Drainage channels and anti-tilt carrier enable Over-the-Beach submerged firing, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.56×45mm NATO through its 368 millimeter bore, the Heckler & Koch HK416D achieves 865 meters per second and 500 meters of effective reach. H&K cold hammer-forged barrel rated beyond 20,000 rounds with 1:7" twist for heavy 77 gr projectiles.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with a 32 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 5.1 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Cold hammer-forged barrel endures suppressed sustained fire with exceptional longevity.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-38), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 30-round 30-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Cold hammer-forged barrel endures suppressed sustained fire with exceptional longevity. Explore BAY-38 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Heckler & Koch HK416D.

zh.kinematicRole: 与相邻模块保持精密基准配合，协同支撑 5.56×45mm NATO 发射周期中的定位、操持与可靠复位。

zh.audioScript: T-01，精密机械扳机与护圈总成。作为 H&K HK416D 短行程活塞战术卡宾枪 的关键构件，它采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物制造，主要承担清晰干脆释放阻铁启动击发职能。与相邻模块保持精密基准配合，协同支撑 5.56×45mm NATO 发射周期中的定位、操持与可靠复位。
